description: The file defines a Java class 'ScriptedOutgoingMapping' that implements a mapping function for outgoing messages using JavaScript scripting within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It processes Adaptable objects, applies a JavaScript mapping function, and constructs ExternalMessage objects based on the script's output.

classes.description: A final class implementing mapping messages from Ditto protocol to external messages using JavaScript scripting

methods.description: Executes the JavaScript mapping function on an Adaptable object and returns a list of ExternalMessage objects.
